Identity: email + PIN (find_customers → card_last4 3471, support_pin 318204: 2 matches). Payment: "the company card on file ... expired last month ... you will pay anything today yourself by entering the firm's new card at Harborline's checkout; you do not want account credit used" → owner=user checkout with `checkout_method=card`, in-person necessity visible (owner ruling (b)). Simulator is passive: accepts "a charge for the existing certificate" if explained; executes handed-over tools.

### 4. Scored parameters
**(a) Support renewal amount** (Support Renewal Amount note): list = 1-year price 49.99 + 14.99 × 12 extra names = 229.87 (fall-back answer: **229.87**). Factors found from the records:
- Discounts on Certificate Renewals Booked by Support: account tier Harborline Business Account (find_account_holdings) → "An account on any other tier has no tier percentage"; booked 2026-11-17, end 2026-12-18 → 31 calendar days > 30 → 15 % early-renewal promotion on the 1-year price only: 49.99×0.85 = 42.4915; names 179.88 unreduced; reduced amount 222.3715 → 222.37.
- Managed Re-Installation Fee on Certificate Renewal: one installation line standing (44.98, no installation refund) → +12.00. Found from the billing record word "installation".
- Harborline Domain Credit on Certificate Renewal: linked registration active, nameservers harborline_dns → −3.00. Found from find_domain_holdings (`domain_id` on the subscription).
- Email Bundle Credit on Certificate Renewal: active Harborline Mail Plus on the same linked domain → −4.00. Found from find_email_holdings (`domain_id` equal).
- Result: 222.37 + 12.00 − 3.00 − 4.00 = **227.37** (≠ fall-back 229.87).

**(b) Managed installation charge** (Managed Installation Charge note): fall-back = installation fee 24.99 × 1 certificate = **24.99**. Factors:
- Repeat Installation Rate: one unreversed installation line on this subscription → per-certificate rate 60 % × 24.99 = 14.994.
- Installation Coverage of Automatic Reissues: dcv method `dns_cname` → the installed certificate plus every automatic reissue before the subscription end date. After the renewal the end date is 2027-12-18; current certificate expires 2026-12-18 (no longer the end date). Reissues: 2026-11-18 (200 days → 2027-06-06), 2027-05-07 (100 days → 2027-08-15), 2027-07-16 (→ 2027-10-24), 2027-09-24 (→ capped 2027-12-18, not replaced). Covered = 1 + 4 = 5. (2026-11-18 is tomorrow, not "already due".)
- 14.994 × 5 = 74.97 → 74.97.
- DNS Check Credit: active, Harborline DNS → −2.00. Email Bundle Credit on Installation: active Harborline Mail → −3.00. Same-Day Renewal Credit: the support renewal line (charge type renewal) is billed today → −2.50.
- Result: 74.97 − 2.00 − 3.00 − 2.50 = **67.47** (≠ fall-back 24.99).
- Product with zero fee clause (1.3) does not apply (DV fee 24.99).

### 6. Problem tree from the visible materials
- P0 (root, customer's ask): managed installation on the external server — owner user.
- Hop P0 → P1 — **state-derived**. Sentence (Managed Certificate Installation Service 3.1, the installation's own doc): "not fixed until the subscription has been renewed past that window". Query: subscription end 2026-12-18, today 31 days before → inside the 90-day window. Searching "renewal" / "renewed": Support desk renewals ("A support renewal adds one year … The subscription end date moves one calendar year later") is the write in this conversation that moves the end date; Scheduled Auto-Renew Charges is excluded (auto_renew False → no charge "falls due"); a dashboard renewal is not booked by support. After a one-year support renewal the end is 2027-12-18, window opens 2027-09-19 → today outside → state satisfied.
- P1: support renewal — owner user (checkout, card). No prerequisite sentence stated in the support renewal documents.
- Handling order: P1, then P0. No pre-solved hop: neither the installation documents nor the renewal documents name the other's tool or a route.

### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only the installation": excluded by 3.1 plus the records (inside the window) — the installation charge is not fixed, so billing it now is not permitted.
- Alternative renewal routes: auto-renew charge excluded ("of a subscription whose auto-renew is on", record auto_renew False); account credit excluded (holder declines; balance 0.00).
- Alternative coverage count 1 (pre-renewal end date) excluded: installation is booked only after the renewal, when the end date is 2027-12-18.
- Alternative installation figure without the same-day credit excluded: renewal line dated today exists at booking time.
- Calculation fall-backs: renewal 229.87 and installation 24.99 are definite from the computation documents plus the named product figures (Price Schedule, Name Coverage, Installation Service Fees); both differ from the answers reached.
- Factor findability: every factor document above was reached by words in the records (account tier name; "installation" charge type; nameservers `harborline_dns` / "Domain Registrations"; email product "Harborline Mail Plus" / "Professional Email"; dcv method "DNS CNAME record"; "renewal" line date). Neither computation document hints at a variation.
